name: Lanthalerhof
beschreibung: The Lanthalerhof is a hotel in Matrei am Brenner. The building is located in the Wipptal near the Brennerpass. The surroundings consist of alpine mountain landscapes and forests. The amenities include guest rooms, a restaurant, and a wellness area. The decor is based on the Alpine country style. The guests are often hikers and skiers. The hotel is open year-round.
